tasks.title: Rebase onto v0.12.0 and reconcile upstream's right-panel work
tasks.detail:
Goal: land the fork on v0.12.0 (pi 1.1.0) with the plugin panel tab kind still working next to upstream's new subagent panel tab.
Files: listed above covers the conflicts plus the panel files both sides own; `package-lock.json` is regenerated in this task's own npm install.
Contract: upstream v0.12.0 added `components/SubagentViewer.tsx` and `lib/panel-layout.ts` and grows MCP/codemode features. The fork added a plugin panel tab (`kind: "plugin"`), `WebPanelFrame` postMessage bridge, `lib/web-panels.ts`, `lib/web-panel-manifest.ts`, and `components/web-panel-tab-state.ts`. Policy:
- Adopt upstream's panel layout/state machinery as the single tab model; re-express the fork plugin tab inside it (same `kind: "plugin"` identity, same manifest reconciliation) instead of keeping a parallel layout implementation.
- `WebPanelFrame` keeps its sandbox attributes, single-load `src` and `open-file` bridge; only its lifecycle hooks change to match the new host.
- AGENTS.md: keep upstream text, re-add the fork sections, and rewrite the web-panel section to describe the reconciled model.
- All other conflicts: take upstream, re-apply fork-only additions per the phase_1 policy.
Steps:
1. `git rebase --onto v0.12.0 fork-next-v0.11.1`.
2. Resolve per policy, commit by commit.
3. `npm install`, then `node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit`; fix drift at its source.
Verify: `git status` clean, no conflict markers, tsc exit 0.
Done when: the fork builds on v0.12.0 with plugin panels and subagent panels coexisting.

Delta fork vs v0.12.0 hanya file milik fork.

tasks.title: Rebase onto v0.12.1 (pi SDK 1.2.0) and absorb the major SDK bump
tasks.detail:
Goal: keep the fork's SDK-facing patches (extension run mode, exact system prompt, sudo askpass bash wrapper) working on pi 1.2.0.
Files: SDK adapter and type files only; unrelated UI files must not be touched here.
Contract: v0.12.1 moves pi from 1.1.0 to 1.2.0. The fork's SDK touchpoints are `PI_WEB_EXTENSION_MODE`, the omitted `onTerminalInput`, percentage overlay widths, the `before_agent_start` exact-prompt extension, and the sudo askpass prefix in the bash tool wrapper. None may be dropped: each has a unit test (`lib/rpc-manager.test.mjs`, `lib/project-command-env.test.mjs`) or is documented in AGENTS.md.
Steps:
1. `git rebase --onto v0.12.1 v0.12.0`.
2. Resolve conflicts, then `npm install` for pi 1.2.0.
3. `node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit`; port each fork patch to the new SDK shape if a signature moved.
4. `npm test`; update fork tests only where the upstream contract legitimately changed, never to hide a lost behaviour.
Verify: tsc exit 0, `npm test` green including `rpc-manager` and `project-command-env` suites.
Done when: pi 1.2.0 compiles with all fork SDK patches intact.
tasks.progress: [2026-10-23T07:37:17Z] rebase --onto v0.12.1 v0.12.0 selesai. Konflik: package.json (19 dep codemirror + blok pi 1.2.0 termasuk pi-mcp/pi-codemode/pi-telemetry), package-lock (diambil upstream lalu diregenerasi npm). SDK 1.2.0 TIDAK butuh perubahan kode: PI_WEB_EXTENSION_MODE, onTerminalInput absen, overlay width, exact system prompt, dan sudo askpass tetap compile. npm install -> pi-coding-agent 1.2.0; tsc --noEmit exit 0; npm test 2726 pass / 0 fail; commit lockfile.

tasks.title: Rebase onto v0.12.2 and tag the final hop
tasks.detail:
Goal: finish the chain on upstream v0.12.2 (the current release) with a fully green worktree.
Files: metadata and documentation; no source file should need a change on a fix-only release.
Contract: v0.12.2 keeps pi 1.2.0 and Next 16.3.8. `LOCAL-CHANGES.md` must describe the rebased fork base (`v0.12.2`) and keep the MIT attribution block.
Steps:
1. `git rebase --onto v0.12.2 v0.12.1`.
2. Resolve metadata conflicts only; `npm install` if the lockfile moved.
3. `node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit`, `npm test`, `npm run lint`.
4. Update `LOCAL-CHANGES.md`: fork base becomes v0.12.2, list the fork features that survived, note anything upstream replaced.
5. Commit and `git tag fork-next-v0.12.2`.
Verify: tsc exit 0, tests green, lint clean, tags `fork-next-v0.10.0`, `fork-next-v0.11.1`, `fork-next-v0.12.2` all resolve, `git rev-list --count v0.12.2..HEAD` equals the fork commit count.
Done when: the worktree sits on v0.12.2 and every check passes.
